subject: Adding Page Refresh Button in shinyapps which works in shinyapps.io

messages.author: a518a8a90723450e
messages.subject: Adding Page Refresh Button in shinyapps which works in shinyapps.io
parts:
Is it possible to add page refresh button in a shiny app?

I tried using shinyjs package to perorm this task using the codes

jsResetCode <- "shinyjs.reset = function() {history.go(0)}",

useShinyjs(),                                           # Include shinyjs in the UI
    extendShinyjs(text = jsResetCode),                      # Add the js code to the page
    p(actionButton("submitplan","Submit Scenario"),actionButton("reset_button", "Reset Tool"))

in the ui

and 

observeEvent(input$reset_button, {js$reset()}) 

However when I deployed it it gave the error ERROR: shinyjs: V8 package is required to use `extendShinyjs`. Please install it with `install.packages("V8")`. althugh I had installed the package and the app is working fine in my pc

Any help in this regard will be greatly appreciated

Thank you

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Adding Page Refresh Button in shinyapps which works in shinyapps.io
parts: Can you try adding library(V8) to the top of your server.R, and try deploying the app to shinyapps.io again? This will be a hint to the shinyapps deployment routines that your app has an implicit V8 dependency.

Hi Rajarshi,
I'm assuming your problem is fixed by now?  Joe is correct. In the README of shinyjs, there's a special section titled "Note about V8 prerequisite" and it does indeed say that if you want to deploy to shinyappsio, you need to include a `library(V8)` somewhere in your code. https://github.com/daattali/shinyjs#note-about-v8-prerequisite
